milestone: One complete bounded fixed-profile H514 projected-CNF pilot and whole-core-family positive cover audit
selection: Exactly the first-input-row representative of each of the 77 public core profiles, in public census order; no adaptive target selection.
encoding: Published H514 optional-P4 projection, 2052 variables, fixed origin colour 0, no other symmetry breaking. Fresh Cadical195 per candidate, defaults, no assumptions or cross-candidate learned clauses.
positive_rule: Check every CNF model, decode old minimum true indicators and a lexicographic P4 extension, directly check all retained edges. Greedily restore omitted vertices in increasing index order to a fixed point; check resulting H514-D four-colouring.
audit_rule: After this fixed pilot, perform exactly one complete known-cut coverage audit over the 190536 canonical cores; separately verify positive witnesses and reproduce coverage without relying on solver statuses.
negative_rule: Stop on native UNSAT and preserve the actual formula for a fresh independent proof. No negative or record claim without exact geometry and checked UNSAT certificate.
unknown_rule: Keep UNKNOWN and unqueried cases explicit; no retries or unchanged-runtime extension.
stop_rule: After bounded pilot and complete positive cover audit, publish warranted exact evidence, make a family-level go/no-go decision, checkpoint and yield before any new support or phase.
scope: Representatives do not decide whole profiles. Residual means not covered, never non-four-colourable.
